Rain fell steadily on the tin roof, a soft percussion that filled the empty barn. Somewhere in the rafters a swallow shifted, wings rustling against old wood. The farmer counted his tools by lantern light, listing each one twice before he trusted the count. Rain fell steadily on the tin roof, a soft percussion that filled the empty barn.
